title: One Way
lyrics_original: I lay my life down at Your feet
Cause You're the only one I need
I turn to You and You are always there
In troubled times it's You I seek
I put You first that's all I need
I humble all I am all to You
One way
Jesus
You're the only one that I could live for
One Way
Jesus
You're the only one that I could live for
You are always, always there
Every how and everywhere
Your grace abounds so deeply within me
You will never ever change
Yesterday today the same
Forever till forever meets no end
You are the Way the Truth and the Life
We live by faith and not by sight for You
We're living all for You

bible_verses.telugu: యేసు నేనే మార్గమును, సత్యమును, జీవమును; నా ద్వారానే తప్ప యెవడును తండ్రియొద్దకు రాడు.
bible_verses.english: Jesus answered, 'I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'

bible_verses.telugu: కాబట్టి మీరు       ఆయన రాజ్యమును నీతిని మొదట వెదకుడి; అప్పు డవన్నియు మీకనుగ్రహింపబడును.
bible_verses.english: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

bible_verses.telugu: మరి ఎవనివలనను రక్షణ కలుగదు; ఈ నామముననే మనము రక్షణ పొందవలెను గాని, ఆకాశము క్రింద మనుష్యులలో ఇయ్యబడిన మరి ఏ నామమున రక్షణ పొందలేము అనెను.
bible_verses.english: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.

devotional.prayer_english: Jesus, I lay my life before You today, acknowledging that You are all I truly need. When life feels overwhelming or uncertain, help me to seek Your face first above everything else. Humble my heart so I can follow You fully without looking back. Thank You for being my constant refuge, my steady anchor, and the only One worth living for. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world filled with distracting choices and constant noise, "One Way" anchors our hearts in the singular devotion Jesus deserves. Laying our lives at His feet is not a burden; it is the joyful surrender of trusting the One who never leaves us. When we seek Him first in troubled times, we discover that He truly is everything we need. Today, as you worship, let your heart rest in the quiet confidence that Jesus is your true direction, your steady refuge, and your reason to live.
